name: Yoga Studio Class Pass

tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.

Japanese.goal: 受付の人にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cushion'

Japanese.goal: 「クッション」という単語を使う

Japanese.goal: 待っている生徒がラウンジで無線インターネットを使えるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ゲスト用のWi-Fiがあるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about cancellation window for reserving limited-capacity evening classes
tasks.hint: Ask how many hours ahead to cancel booking.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about class reservation cancellation window.

Japanese.goal: 定員の少ない夜のレッスンの予約は何時間前までにキャンセルできるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 予約を何時間前までにキャンセルすればいいか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if studio offers soundproof meditation pods for individual practice
tasks.hint: Inquire about private meditation booth access.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about soundproof individual meditation pods.

Japanese.goal: 一人で練習できる防音の瞑想ブースがあるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 個室の瞑想ブースを使えるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed receipt for corporate health insurance reimbursement
tasks.hint: Ask receptionist for insurance-compliant invoice.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed receipt for insurance reimbursement.

Japanese.goal: 会社の健康保険の払い戻し用に紙の領収書を頼む
Japanese.hint: 保険の申請に使える請求書を受付の人にお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Report cold draft from air vent and ask to adjust thermostat before class
tasks.hint: Inform receptionist room draft feels chilly.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported air vent cold draft and asked to adjust thermostat.
tasks.scene_hint: A soothing indoor water fountain trickles gently beside potted monstera plants.

Japanese.goal: エアコンの吹き出し口から冷たい風が来ると伝えて、レッスン前に温度調整を頼む
Japanese.hint: 部屋にすきま風があって寒いことを受付の人に伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if studio features ambient dimmable salt lamps during evening classes
tasks.hint: Inquire about evening lighting setup.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ambient salt lamp lighting in evening.

Japanese.goal: 夜のレッスンで明るさを調整できる岩塩ランプを使っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 夜のレッスンの照明について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about workshops focusing on chakra alignment and energy work
tasks.hint: Ask about upcoming chakra energy seminars.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about chakra alignment workshop schedule.
tasks.scene_hint: Calming wall mural depicting lotus flowers frames the entry to the main practice hall.

Japanese.goal: チャクラを整えるエネルギーワークのワークショップについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 今後のチャクラのエネルギーセミナーについて聞いてみましょう。
